name: Steel sheet-pile wall with a channel cap and tie-rods
in_game: New: a bank kind for marinas, the dam and commercial frontage (placement by rule, Track I)
real: Interlocking Z-profile steel sheets driven in a corrugated line, a steel channel capping the tops, a waler along the face with tie-rod nuts every few sheets. Mill scale going to rust, rust streaks under every nut, heavy rust and algae in the splash zone.

tie_spacing.source: typical lakefront construction in North Texas; to confirm against Bean's grey-card photos

wall_above_pool.source: typical lakefront construction in North Texas; to confirm against Bean's grey-card photos

budget.note: the corrugation at 4 cm steps is for the close camera; a 0.15 m step is enough past 30 m

layers: edge_layer.py: wet line, stain band, scum line, algae, run-off, wrack (cards/layers.json)
references_wanted: the same stretch from a boat 15 m off, midday, grey card on the face or the ground
from 5 m, the waterline and the stain band, card in frame
a close-up (1 m) of the surface with a coin or the card for scale
the same place at a low lake (autumn) if possible: the band and what the water left
periodic_by_design: a pile pair every 1.118 m, tie-rods every 2.236 m
